title: board command crashes with EPIPE when its output is cut off (| head)
notes: Seen 2026-11-16: `board list | head` and `board show <id> | head` throw an unhandled 'write EPIPE' with a Node stack trace (board-cli-entry.js). A closed stdout should end the command quietly with exit 0, like any Unix tool. Handle EPIPE on stdout in board-cli-entry.ts, check the pane/session command entries for the same bug, and add a test. Do not bump the version.

comments.body: From main-dashboard: tests must be Windows-safe. Run pnpm test, typecheck and lint.
Pull request #308 opened: End the commands quietly when their output is cut off (| head) https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/pull/308
